name: zotero-mcp
description: Connect Claude Code to local Zotero tools.

zotero_debug_bridge_token.title: Zotero Debug Bridge token
zotero_debug_bridge_token.description: Local token from your Zotero Debug Bridge plugin. Stored in Claude Code plugin settings for compatibility with current userConfig injection.

zotero_library_id.title: Zotero library ID
zotero_library_id.description: Local Zotero library id. Use 1 for the default personal library.

zotero_api_key.title: Zotero Web API key
zotero_api_key.description: Optional Zotero Web API key for remote/cloud workflows. Stored in Claude Code plugin settings for compatibility with current userConfig injection.

zotero_user_id.title: Zotero user ID
zotero_user_id.description: Optional Zotero user id for Web API workflows.

zotero_group_id.title: Zotero group ID
zotero_group_id.description: Optional Zotero group id for Web API workflows.

crossref_email.title: Crossref email
crossref_email.description: Optional real contact email used for CrossRef and Unpaywall requests.
